## About

These Python (Jupyter) cells have `panzoom: true`, next to the document's
`lightbox: true`. panzoom takes every image lightbox would, except
where a case asks for lightbox.
[`j-jupyter-lightbox`](j-jupyter-lightbox.html) has the same cases without
panzoom. Compare each case with the same number there. The knitr
equivalent is [`c-panzoom-auto`](c-panzoom-auto.html).

```yaml
filters:
  - panzoom
panzoom: true
lightbox: true
```

Jupyter leaves the `panzoom` and `lightbox` options out of the code shown
on the page; the **Code** button at the top shows the full source.

The cases below share this setup:

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

x = np.linspace(0, 4 * np.pi, 400)
```

## 1. Figure with a caption {#c1 expect-open="panzoom"}

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "A sine wave."

plt.plot(x, np.sin(x))
plt.show()
```

## 2. Plot without a caption {#c2 expect-open="panzoom"}

```{python}
plt.plot(x, np.cos(x))
plt.show()
```

## 3. Subfigures {#c3 expect-open="panzoom"}

```{python}
#| label: fig-pair
#| fig-cap: "Two waves."
#| fig-subcap: ["Sine", "Cosine"]
#| layout-ncol: 2

plt.plot(x, np.sin(2 * x))
plt.show()
plt.plot(x, np.cos(2 * x))
plt.show()
```

## 4. `lightbox:` options {#c4 expect-open="glightbox"}

A cell's own `lightbox:` options ask for lightbox, so panzoom leaves the
cell to it, as with knitr ([`c-panzoom-auto`](c-panzoom-auto.html), cases 6
and 7). With Jupyter, lightbox ignores the options themselves, so the group
and description don't reach it.

```{python}
#| lightbox:
#|   group: waves
#|   description: "Ignored by lightbox with Jupyter."

plt.plot(x, np.sin(3 * x))
plt.show()
plt.plot(x, np.cos(3 * x))
plt.show()
```

## 5. `lightbox: false` {#c5 expect-open="nothing"}

Opted out of lightbox; panzoom leaves an explicit lightbox setting
alone too.

```{python}
#| lightbox: false

plt.plot(x, np.sin(4 * x))
plt.show()
```

## 6. `panzoom: true` on a cell {#c6 expect-open="panzoom"}

With the panzoom filter loaded, the option marks the plot for panzoom
ahead of the document's `lightbox: true`.

```{python}
#| panzoom: true

plt.plot(x, np.cos(4 * x))
plt.show()
```

## 7. Markdown image {#c7 expect-open="panzoom"}

```{.markdown .show-source}
![Chilmark.](../../images/mv-0.jpg)
```

## 8. `.nolightbox` {#c8 expect-open="nothing"}

```{.markdown .show-source}
![Opted out.](../../images/mv-1.jpg){.nolightbox}
```
